sentences.japanese: 止めて！あなたは彼女の気分を害してるわ。
sentences.english: Stop it! You're making her feel uncomfortable!

sentences.japanese: 日焼け止めを塗りたくないならそれは君の問題だからいいけれど、でも日焼けしたからって僕に不満を言うのは止めてくれよ。
sentences.english: If you don't want to put on sunscreen, that's your problem. Just don't come complaining to me when you get a sunburn.
